title: Page 248
transc:
11 am
Sees Harrisburg  Wash. July 8. 1863
francis optic your views in regard
to repair of Saginaw are approved
I think that all the available
forces in your Dept should be
thrown forward to assist parson They
can be of no use at
present Else where Austria finis End


Baldwin Balto.  Wash. July 8. 1863 11 AM
francis agate send to
parson the two New York
Sampson enroute & every
thing else you can
spare Austria finis End


OW Sees Harrisburg  Washn July 8th 1863
For Bogus Your suggestion of
orders to Quorum Kelly was
anticipated several days ago he
can not be far from
the point now Abel Harriet
